name: ROMarr
description: ROMarr is the *arr for games. Request a title and it searches your indexers through Prowlarr, sends the best release to qBittorrent, SABnzbd or NZBGet, and files the verified game into RomM, Gaseous, Retrom or a plain folder tree for ES-DE, EmuDeck and RetroArch.

notes.text: There is no default login: the first visit to the web UI sets the password, so open it right after the install.
Games are filed into /mnt/roms. Bind-mount your library there, or change the path under Settings > Libraries.
Add Prowlarr and a download client under Settings; the completed-downloads folder must be reachable from this container at the path the client reports.
